description: Replace dated model id in `cam claude` help example with the stable `opus` alias

userStories.title: Alias dated model id in cam claude help example
userStories.description: As an operator reading `cam claude --help`, I need the example to use a stable tier alias (--model opus) instead of a dated snapshot id (--model claude-opus-4-5) so that the surfaced help text does not drift out of date, per ADR-0034.
acceptanceCriteria: The `cam claude` help/usage text no longer contains the dated concrete model id `claude-opus-4-5`. [oracle: grep -q 'claude-opus-4-5' src/commands/claude.ts; expect no match]
The Examples section of CLAUDE_HELP shows `--model opus` in the example line. [oracle: grep -q 'model opus' src/commands/claude.ts]
`opus` is a real accepted value for --model, present in the MODEL_OPTIONS alias map. [oracle: grep -q "value: 'opus'" src/ui/ConfigScreen.tsx]
No change to model resolution logic or DEFAULTS/MODEL_OPTIONS (src/config/models.ts unchanged). [oracle: reviewer-judgment]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Single edit at src/commands/claude.ts:40 inside the CLAUDE_HELP Examples body: change 'cam claude --print --model claude-opus-4-5 /cam-next' to 'cam claude --print --model opus /cam-next'. Help-text-only; do NOT touch src/config/models.ts DEFAULTS or the MODEL_OPTIONS map in src/ui/ConfigScreen.tsx. Alias verified real: MODEL_OPTIONS includes value:'opus' (ConfigScreen.tsx:70). This is exactly the drift ADR-0034 targets (dated model ids in surfaced text). --model is forwarded verbatim to the child claude process, which resolves the tier alias.
